name: Gift Xiao Lantern
desc: A special Xiao Lantern, specially crafted by the Ministry of Civil Affairs. With these Xiao Lanterns, you can send various gifts to your companions. Can be equipped in the item slot and used in Liyue Harbor to release the corresponding Xiao Lantern.

value.text: Obtained from the "A Lanternlit Ode to the Silver Moon" event
